purpose: Protected gate lists: planning targets that must currently hold, and the approved required case ids that prove them.
changePolicy: Entries here are the required baseline. Removing an entry, downgrading a required target to planned, moving a case out of the list, or softening an approved expectation must be reviewed explicitly by a human and recorded in the linked GitHub issue or PR; validators and CI hard-fail on silent removal, missing, or emptying entries. requiredCaseIds starts empty only as the documented pre-TM-04 initial state and must be complete before any required gate can pass.
